health.description: Check if the API is running

query.description: Query the RAG system with orchestrator
query.example: curl -X POST http://localhost:8011/api/v1/query -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -d '{"query": "Who is Iron Man?", "top_k": 5}'

query_streaming.example: curl -X POST http://localhost:8011/api/v1/query -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -d '{"query": "Who is Iron Man?", "stream": true}'

query_direct.example: curl -X POST http://localhost:8011/api/v1/query -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -d '{"query": "Who is Iron Man?", "use_orchestrator": false}'

payload.query: What are Tony Stark abilities and enemies?
Tell me about the arc reactor
How did Tony Stark become Iron Man?
Is Iron Man part of the Avengers?
What are Iron Man suit capabilities?
How did Tony Stark character evolve?

curl_examples.basic_query: curl -X POST http://localhost:8011/api/v1/query -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -d '{"query": "Who is Iron Man?", "top_k": 5}'
curl_examples.streaming_query: curl -X POST http://localhost:8011/api/v1/query -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -d '{"query": "Who is Iron Man?", "stream": true}'
curl_examples.direct_mode: curl -X POST http://localhost:8011/api/v1/query -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -d '{"query": "Who is Iron Man?", "use_orchestrator": false}'
curl_examples.with_top_k: curl -X POST http://localhost:8011/api/v1/query -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -d '{"query": "What are Tony Stark abilities?", "top_k": 10}'
curl_examples.pretty_json: curl -X POST http://localhost:8011/api/v1/query -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -d '{"query": "Who is Iron Man?"}' | jq .

response_structure.answer: string - The generated answer to the query

sources.chunk_id: string - Unique identifier for the chunk

faithfulness.faithfulness_score: float - How well answer is supported by context
faithfulness.unsupported_sentences: array - Sentences not supported by context

relevance.context_relevance_score: float - How relevant context is to query

source_coverage.source_coverage_score: float - How well sources cover the answer

trace.tokens: object - Token usage for this step

notes.top_k: Controls how many document chunks to retrieve. Higher values provide more context but increase latency and cost.
notes.use_orchestrator: When true, uses full agent pipeline (Planner → Retriever → Reasoner → Critic). When false, uses direct retrieval + generation.
notes.stream: When true, returns Server-Sent Events (SSE) for real-time token streaming. Useful for chat interfaces.
notes.caching: Responses are cached automatically. Identical queries return cached results instantly.
notes.evaluation: All responses include quality metrics: faithfulness, relevance, hallucination detection, and confidence scores.
notes.hybrid_retrieval: Combines vector search (semantic) and BM25 (keyword) for optimal retrieval. Alpha=0.5 by default.
